stem: 某银行的新任客户尽职调查(KYC)负责人特别注重强化其KYC计划中的风险管理部分，并提及了巴塞尔委员会的客户尽职调查(CDD)原则。以下哪两项描述了巴塞尔委员会客户尽职调查原则中所确立的KYC(了解你的客户)计划的关键改进？(选择两项。)

options.A: 对此前已发现并调查过可疑活动的代理行客户实施黑名单制度
options.B: 完善客户接受政策，更明确地识别高风险客户
options.C: 提高前台员工培训的频率
options.D: 加强客户身份识别程序，以适当识别信托、代名和受托账户

stem_en: The new head of KYC at a bank is particularly focused on strengthening the risk management component of the bank's KYC program and refers to the Basel Committee's customer due diligence (CDD) principles. Which two of the following describe key improvements to a KYC program established in the Basel Committee CDD principles? (Select Two.)

options_en.A: Implementing a blacklist for correspondent banking customers whose suspicious activity was previously detected and investigated
options_en.B: Enhancing the customer acceptance policy to more clearly identify high-risk customers
options_en.C: Increasing the frequency of front-line staff training
options_en.D: Enhancing customer identification procedures to appropriately identify trust, nominee, and fiduciary accounts
